title: Test recipe scaling, stats extraction, and step combining
description: Write Swift Testing unit tests (import Testing, @Test, #expect — not XCTest) in three files. RecipeScaleTests: apply(to:) for .number × all four factors, .text passthrough, nil quantity; apply(toServings:) for integer scaling, rounding, minimum-1, and unparseable passthrough. RecipeStatsTests: all five stats extracted when all metadata keys are present; each stat individually hidden when its key is absent. RecipeStepCombinerTests: combine() produces the expected string for a step mixing text items, ingredient refs, cookware refs, and timer refs.
acceptance_criteria: RecipeStatsTests.swift verifies all five stats present when all keys exist.
RecipeStatsTests.swift verifies each stat is individually absent when its key is missing.
RecipeStepCombinerTests.swift verifies a mixed-item step produces the correct combined string.
All tests use Swift Testing syntax: import Testing, @Test, #expect.
All tests pass via xcodebuild test.
